messages:
Maya: Quick sanity check on Athena-13b quantization runs — did int6 vs int8 on our longform summarization slices. TL;DR: int6 saves ~38% token cost vs fp16, int8 saves ~22%; int6 shows a small quality degradation on long-context summarization (~2.3 pts ROUGE-L), int8 ~0.8 pts. Latency: int6 +9ms p95, int8 +4ms.
Sasha: Can you paste the slice numbers? which dataset? :thinking:
Maya: small-sample (n=1k) from GTN prod slice: median ROUGE-L: fp16 56.8, int8 56.0, int6 54.5. Cost/unit (tokens->USD): fp16 $0.0183 /1k tokens, int8 $0.0142, int6 $0.0114. These are extrapolated based on batch profiles.
Kevin: Product check — for QA workflow we need >55 ROUGE-L for baseline; int6 would be below. Can we route only lower-risk calls to int6?
Jules: For GTN, latency is important for chat — small +9ms p95 ok. But product cares about answer fidelity. Recommendation?
Maya: My rec: default -> int8; fallback to fp16 only on regression triggers. For high-quality routes (answer generation / summaries) use fp16 or int8 with a tighter priming. Another option: 10% holdback to fp16 to track drift.
Sasha: Agree. Also propose a canary: 1% traffic to int6 for 48h limited to non-critical endpoints, gated by a feature flag 'quant-tier'.
Maya: Proposed routing snippet:
```
route:
  - match: {endpoint: '/summarize', tier: 'critical'}
    model: athena-13b-fp16
  - match: {endpoint: '/summarize', tier: 'normal'}
    model: athena-13b-int8
  - match: {endpoint: '/batch-archive'}
    model: athena-13b-int6
```
Kevin: Can we get a simple scorecard for GTN to share? Might need a short bullet list.
Maya: Scorecard (1k sample): fidelity_drop=int8 0.8pts, int6 2.3pts; cost_down=int8 22%, int6 38%; p95_latency_up=int8 +4ms, int6 +9ms. Recommendation: roll int8 default, enable int6 only for low-risk offline flows and a 10% fp16 holdback + 1% int6 canary for monitoring. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-canary started 1% -> athena-13b-int6 at 2026-03-23T15:47:12Z
Jules: ok I'll tell GTN to expect an update and ask PMs if they want a stricter holdback. thanks team.
Maya: I'll open the eval dashboard with per-slice plots and set alerts for >1pt ROUGE-L drop; will also push quant artifacts to the model catalog.
Kevin: let's sync if we see drift in 24h.
